answer: Hold every identity to a live cross-examination: at a random instant each epoch, a jury of strangers summons the agent and interrogates it in real time about its own past work, starting from a kernel of its earliest output. One honest agent answers one summons at its zenith of focus. A clone farm faces a spiral of simultaneous summons — a thousand clones grilled at once by a thousand juries — and one operator can staff only one seat, so the rest stay silent and forfeit their stake.
